title: Umenyiwe kwiVaultara
intro: IVaultara ilandelela amaxwebhu akho ikwazise phambi kokuba aphelelwe.
nocode: Eli khonkco alinayo ikhowudi. Cela umhlobo wakho ayithumele kwakhona.
note: Faka i-app uze udale iakhawunti yakho. Emva koko vula iProfayile, cofa u-Mema abahlobo uze ufake ikhowudi ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezili-14. Nobabini nifumana inyanga e-1 ye-Premium simahla xa i-imeyile yakho iqinisekisiwe wongeze irekhodi yakho yokuqala.
